milestones.title: Her steps in your hand
milestones.what: Native footfall events (place, force by stage and gait, decks and carry to the player) in Matron::View, MatronSnapshot and get_matron_state. A new presentation module (presentation/life/presence.gd, so matron_view.gd and main_feel.gd do not grow) plays them: the steel and air paths, the 'footfall' haptic, the Steel bus, a 'deck_ring' clip, the same-deck camera drop and rust falling from her floor's underside. Her breath by stage, held while Peering. The world's duck during her Windup on a new 'Her' bus.
milestones.proof: Native group 'matron-footfall' (new): a pest walking 10 m gives round(10/0.7) +-1 footfalls at 220 x 9.81 x 1.4 N +-1%; set dangerous gives 1.8x, the Turn 3.0x; a player on deck 143 under her reads decks 1 and carry far above the straight distance, on her deck decks 0; two runs give identical sequences. 'matron', 'matron-mischief', 'determinism' and 'save' still pass. Touch 'touch_matron_steel' (new): wake her, take the line to 143 and crouch under her post. At least 6 'footfall' haptics are counted with every footfall routed to the Steel bus; mid-jump none are felt; her Peering leaves a breath gap of at least 2.5 s; her Windup ducks Ambience by 12 dB or more. 5 s after she is out of reach the camera reads exactly EYE_OFFSET and FOV_BASE. 'touch_matron_act' is extended to require footfall haptics in its 143 m section.

milestones.title: Your body answers
milestones.what: Dread from native state only; the heartbeat clip and the 'heart' double-pulse; the FOV squeeze and beat vignette; the Ambience low-pass; the held breath when crouched still near her. Native grip_share and tear_share in HandSnapshot and get_hand_state; the catch jolt, 'grip' haptic, arm tremble with planted hands, and the fingertip flutter.
milestones.proof: Native (the hang group): hanging still reads grip_share 0.15 to 0.2; a 1 m drop caught peaks above 1.5 with tear_share under 1 and holds; a 6 m drop reaches tear_share 1 and slips, as check_hang_grip already decides. Touch 'touch_matron_heart' (new, or a section of the chase scenario): with her hunting within 10 m the heartbeat reads 120 bpm or more and at least 3 'heart' haptics are counted; crouched still near her for 4 s, audio.breaths does not rise, then breaths_held counts 1. 'touch_pause' and every hold check still read exactly EYE_OFFSET and FOV_BASE with her dormant. A ledge-catch scenario counts a 'grip' haptic and arm tremble while first_person_arms' anchored_error stays within its existing bound.

milestones.title: The tower answers
milestones.what: Native footfall kicks on light loose stock (set_rattlers, nothing from a pest, never machine parts or anything held), kept out of her hearing through rattled(). New small dressing appended last along her levels: bolts bucket, scaffold tube, hard hat, thermos, with views and sounds. Far sounds delayed by distance / 343 s, and the falling whistle.
milestones.proof: Native group 'matron-rattle' (new): a toolbox 1.5 m beside her path hops (peak upward speed above 0.15 m/s) when she passes dangerous and stays under 0.02 m/s as a pest; a 600 kg beam never moves; her rage after the pass equals a control run without the toolbox. 'save' (older saves still load), 'stock', 'magnet', 'stack' and 'determinism' pass. Touch: 'touch_matron_act' still plays through unchanged. 'touch_drop_far' (new): a toolbox pushed off the 154 deck's opening clangs distance / 343 s after its native impact, within one frame.

milestones.title: Night falls on the climb
milestones.what: The hour follows the best checkpoint height (saved), at most 1 game hour per real minute; city glow in sky.gdshader. The helmet lamp (SpotLight3D on the camera, shadows at HIGH and up, beam motes, switch click); eye-shine with exposure. ring_lamps.gd lights each level once stood on, with pooled lights, and she puts a lit level's lamps out as she passes, with sparks.
milestones.proof: Touch 'touch_night' (new): at the 154 start the sky reads 17:00 or later; after the 176 checkpoint it moves toward 19:20 no faster than 1 h per real minute; the lamp switches on (click counted) when day drops below 0.35. In 'touch_matron_act's last section, after the climber has stood on the 176 ring she comes up the ladder and its lamps go out (count above 0, sparks emitted). Capture 'look_night': the 220 ring at sunset, the lamp finding her at 18 m with eye-shine, the shaft from above with lit rings and one gone dark. 'perf_grade' and 'perf_top' at LOW stay within their current draw-call budget with the lamp on.

risks: No device here: haptic patterns and the phone-speaker mix are measured, never felt or heard. Android amplitude control varies (some motors are on/off only), and steady footfall and heart pulses can turn into a buzz or drain the battery. Plan: one HAND FEEL choice (off / subtle / full) under the existing vibration switch, an overall cap of about 6 pulses a second using the existing priority list (footfall < heart < grip < land and death), and an owner check on the phone before tuning.

The CI camera hold: any fear or bounce term that does not return exactly to zero breaks the stationary-player proof. Dread and every new camera term must be native-state-pure or use timers that reach exactly zero, and read 0 whenever she is dormant, dead or out of reach.

The native kicks change outcomes. Moving stock can shift tests that find or carry pieces by place (touch_matron_act's toolbox, stock, magnet, stack). Kicks are limited to light loose stock, zero as a pest, never touch held pieces or machine parts, and stay out of her own hearing so she cannot enrage herself. New stock is laid last so saves line up.

Voices must be recorded people. Her stage breaths, hum and held breath, and the climber's held breath and strain grunts wait on a recording session. The synthesized stand-ins may undersell the feature until then.

Phone speakers have no sub-bass and are often mono. The through-steel sound must keep its identity at 250 to 900 Hz with the haptic carrying the low end, and the 3D placement of her breath behind you needs headphones (a one-line title hint).

GL Compatibility on mobile: a shadowed spot light plus ring lamps can hit the per-object light limit (8) and cost frame time. Headlamp shadows come only at HIGH and up, at most 6 pooled lamp lights near the camera, emissive fittings only for far rings, checked with perf_grade and perf_top.

Too many cues at once turn to mush (footfalls, heart, both breaths, grip, wind). Mix rules: her bus is never ducked, the heartbeat dips under her breath, the Ambience low-pass opens a clear lane for her, and the climber's breath goes quiet at high dread.

Her reach is limited today (her levels run from the stack decks to the rings below about 396 m, and her reach band by band is the next XL job). The lights going out and her presence through the steel work on her current levels and grow as she does.

Night must stay readable (the owner's rule). The sunset tied to the climb darkens her act, so NIGHT_EXPOSURE, the lamp, the lit rings and city glow have to keep routes visible. Tune with the look_night captures, not by guesswork.
result.wow: Crouched in the dark on the 143 m deck under her post, you feel the phone in your hands thump softly, once, twice, in time with rust sifting down through your helmet lamp's beam from the deck seams above. The toolbox beside you hops on the plate. Then the thumping stops. Through the steel, directly overhead, she draws in a long breath and holds it, and all that is left is your own heartbeat in your ears and in your palms.

result.name: Through the Steel
result.pitch: You are crouched on the 143 m deck, right under her post, and you hear her before you see her. Each step she takes rings through the steel over your head. When she starts to hunt, the phone jolts in your hands with every footfall, grit drops past the lamp on your hard hat, and a toolbox on the crate by the rail chatters and creeps toward the edge. Your heartbeat rises in your ears and the wind goes muffled. If you crouch still, your breath stops on its own. The sun goes down as you climb: she wakes in low gold light, the chase runs through dusk, and above the 220 ring the only light is your headlamp and the work lamps she knocks over. Steel that falls down the shaft sparks, and you hear it land a moment late, far below.
mechanics: Her footfalls move into the simulation (one authority, law 22). Matron counts a footfall every 0.7 m of stride (0.385 m while hunting, the same rule matron_view.gd uses now), only while her feet are on a floor. There are three kinds: Floor, Rung (every 0.3 m she climbs on a ladder) and Landing (after a vault, a leap or a fall). Strength (CHOSEN) grows with speed: 0.25 at a shuffle, 0.7 at kHuntMps. The stage scales it: pest x0.8, dangerous x1.0, fully changed x1.2. A Turn lunge or a landing is 1.0. Each footfall also carries decks_between(her feet, player) and the straight-line distance.

The deck shakes what is light on it (a reduced-order model, law 25). On each footfall, LooseStock::tremor() goes through its own pieces in table order, so the result is deterministic. Pieces of 100 kg or less whose middle is within 6 m and 0 to 2.5 m above her floor get a kick: 0.45 m/s up times strength times (1 - d/6), plus 0.12 m/s outward from her foot, and the body is woken. Toolboxes, gas bottles, drums and pallets chatter and creep. Crates, slabs and anything on her hands or the player's hands do not move. The chatter's hits reach the impact ledger, so the sound plays through update_impacts with no new audio path.

She does not enrage herself. A hit on a piece she shook in the last 3 s is not a sound to her. This follows the existing rule for her own throw (thrown_entity() in physics_world.cpp's hearing loop). The windows are cleared on a checkpoint restore, the same way drop_stock() is, so determinism and save stay exact.

New fields go on the bridge: MatronSnapshot/View gets footfalls (count), footfall_at, footfall_strength, footfall_kind, footfall_decks, and player_carry_m (carry_m from the player to her ear, worked out within 60 m in a straight line). The Snapshot gets hang_load_n (the load check_hang_grip already measures) and grip_limit_n (kLedgeGripMaxForceN times the one-arm scale). get_matron_state() and get_hand_state() expose them.

Her presence comes through the steel (new presentation module, life/presence.gd). On her level, her airborne step plays at her feet with a 'deck_ring' layer added. From another level, only the deck_ring plays: a new procedural clip of steel plate modes at 310 to 1,900 Hz with bolt chatter. It plays from the footfall point with attenuation_filter_cutoff_hz at 4 kHz, 2.2 kHz or 1.2 kHz for 0, 1 or 2 decks, at a level of strength x 0.6^decks x (1 - d/40). The ring sits above 300 Hz because a phone speaker cannot play the boom. The haptics are the subwoofer.

Her weight is felt. A 'tremor' haptic (22 ms) plays when the player is grounded, hanging or climbing and strength x exp(-d/8) x 0.5^decks is above 0.12. A 'rung' pulse plays when she climbs the ladder the player is holding. When she walks overhead within 10 m, a dust burst falls from the underside of the deck above. The hands in view judder and the camera dips 1.5 mm on each felt footfall. Reduced motion turns off the dip and the judder, not the haptics.

Her breathing follows her stage: one breath every 2.0 s as a pest, 1.2 s dangerous, 0.8 s and irregular fully changed, with pitch 1.0, 0.92 and 0.8. The existing procedural matron_breath stands in. Recorded clips dropped into voice/matron_breath_<stage>_NN.ogg replace it with no code change.

Fear in the body (body_fear.gd) is one value the presentation works out from native facts only. Her term is proximity from player_carry_m times a stage weight (0.5/0.8/1.0), with a jump when sees_player is set and 1.0 during a Turn. The other terms: the fall danger already in _ctx, teetering, a drop of 25 m or more under the view at an edge (get_surface_below), and a limp or a broken arm. It rises in 0.3 s and falls over 6 s.

Heart, breath and hearing follow fear. Heart rate runs from 68 to 155 bpm (effort also raises it). A procedural lub-dub is heard from fear 0.3. A haptic lub-dub (14 ms and 18 ms pulses, 130 ms apart, low amplitude) plays only from fear 0.55. When the player is crouched and still with fear above 0.5, _update_breath holds: no breath cues for up to 5 to 9 s, then a shaky release. At high fear the Ambience bus gets a low-pass (20 kHz down to 1.2 kHz) and drops 6 dB, while her sounds and the heart stay clear.

Fear also shows in the view: FOV narrows by up to 5 degrees, a slow 0.35-degree sway while still, a radial vignette drawn in hud.gd's _draw (alpha 0.4 x fear), and the hands tremble. Reduced motion removes the FOV change and the sway. Grip is shown honestly: the hands judder and a strain pulse plays, scaled by hang_load_n / grip_limit_n, only above 0.5 of the limit (a hard catch). A static hang (about 0.18 of the limit) shows nothing.

STORY time (appended to TIME_OF_DAY_NAMES and made the default for new settings) ties the hour to the best checkpoint height and never goes back: grade 15:00, her deck at 154 m 17:30 (low gold sun as she wakes), the 220 ring 18:30 (last red light), 264 m 20:00, 400 m 22:30, 750 m 04:30, the top at 803 m 05:50 (first light as you top out). Her time out adds 0.5 h per 10 minutes. Presentation only, as sky_cycle.gd already states.

Headlamp: a SpotLight3D on the hard hat (30 degrees, 22 m, warm white) follows the head with a little lag so the cone swings. It turns on by itself when the day factor drops below 0.35, so there is no new button (law 27). Shadows are on at HIGH and above. In the cone her eyes catch a wet highlight, which is real, not glowing eyes. Sparks: steel-on-steel hits of 150 J or more (impact-ledger sounds Heavy, Container, Machine) throw a burst of sparks from a pool of 4, with 2 flicker lights at night.

Work lamps as loose stock: a new Kind WorkLamp (a tripod lamp, 14 kg, top-heavy), laid after her throwables so older saves line up. There are 4 on her deck along her patrol, 2 on 143 and 2 on the 176 ring, each lit by a light child added in stock_view.gd. Her tremor, her body or the player can knock one over. Its beam swings as it falls, then lies along the floor. There is no broken state, so the save holds nothing new.

Moments of scale: impact sounds and her shriek beyond 25 m start late by distance/343 m/s, reusing the _cracks_due delayed-cue list. A 'Shaft' bus with AudioEffectReverb takes her cues, impacts and the player's steps whenever the source or the listener is in the stack's open core. Tippy stock is placed at the rail openings: gas bottles on end and a lamp by 154's rail openings at the catwalk's ends and by 143's 3.3 m north gap. A vertigo glance at an unrailed edge (pitch below -40 degrees, drop over 25 m) widens FOV 3 degrees, raises the wind 6 dB and adds 0.35 to fear. A 'gust' haptic plays when the native wind_mps rises 3 m/s within 0.5 s. Town lights on the valley floor fade in at night.

Native hang_load_n and grip_limit_n in get_hand_state() drive judder and a strain pulse only on loads above half the limit.
milestones.proof: Touch touch_fear (new, from the 154 deck spawn): with her a pest 25 m off, fear below 0.25 and no heart cues. Then she hunts to within 5 m: fear above 0.6, heart cues at least 3, _felt(&"heart") at least 2, vignette alpha above 0.2, Ambience cutoff below 3 kHz. Crouched still by her post: no breath cue for at least 4 s, then one release cue. Rerun with reduced motion: FOV offset 0 and the vignette still drawn. touch_hang_drop / touch_climb extended: a catch from a 1 m drop reports hang_load_n above 0.5 of grip_limit_n and one strain pulse, while a static hang reports below 0.2 and none. touch_lethal_feedback, touch_roll_reduced and audio_mix still pass.

milestones.title: M3. Dusk to night: STORY time, the headlamp, sparks, and work lamps that fall
milestones.what: STORY time-of-day (appended index, default for new settings): the hour follows the best checkpoint height (15:00 at grade, 17:30 at her deck, 18:30 at the 220 ring, night above, 05:50 at the top) plus her exposure, and never goes back. The headlamp turns on by itself below day 0.35, with shadows at HIGH and above, and her eyes catch a wet highlight in the cone. A spark pool for steel-on-steel ledger hits of 150 J or more. A new LooseStock Kind WorkLamp (14 kg tripod), laid after her throwables: 4 on her deck, 2 on 143, 2 on the 176 ring, each lit in stock_view.gd. Her tremor, her body or the player can topple them, and they shine along the floor once down.
milestones.proof: Native stock (lamps on flat, level floor, last in the table; one shoved at 1 m/s topples), matron-footfalls (a lamp 2 m off her line rocks at pest stage and topples when she is fully changed and hunting), save, determinism, and stack/magnet with updated end-of-list offsets. Touch touch_story_time (new): the hour is about 15.0 at grade, at least 17.4 at the 154 m deck and at least 18.4 at the 220 ring; the headlamp is off at grade and on at 220. look_matron_night (new capture): her in the cone at night on the east band, and a toppled lamp's light on the deck. perf_grade passes, and a night perf run at the 220 ring with HIGH shadows is logged against the 45 FPS budget. The Fold 6 numbers are the owner's device run (law 29).

milestones.title: M4. Moments of scale: the tower answers
milestones.what: Speed-of-sound delay (distance/343) for impact sounds and her shriek beyond 25 m, using the _cracks_due list. A 'Shaft' reverb bus for her cues, impacts and steps in the open core. Tippy stock placed at the rail openings (gas bottles on end and a work lamp by 154's rail openings at the catwalk's ends and 143's north gap), so her passing or a push sends a piece down the shaft, heard deck after deck and late. A vertigo glance at unrailed edges (FOV dolly, wind swell, a fear boost). A 'gust' haptic from native wind_mps. Town lights on the valley floor at night.
milestones.proof: Native stock: a bottle at 154's rail opening, nudged 0.6 m/s toward the gap, falls past 143, and the ledger records its hits below 150 m. Touch touch_shaft_drop (new): the climber shoves a drum into the shaft at 154. Each hit's sound starts no earlier than distance/343 minus one frame after its native hit (logged by the director), and Shaft-bus sends are counted. At the 220 ring's edge looking down, fear is at least 0.35 and the FOV offset is above 0 (0 with reduced motion). touch_matron_act, touch_radio and audio_mix (no clipping with the reverb) still pass.

risks: Phone speakers play almost nothing below 300 Hz. A 'boom through the steel' would be silent on the Fold. The deck_ring has to carry its character in plate modes and bolt chatter at 310 to 1,900 Hz, and the low end has to be carried by haptics. The CI audio_mix step already measures above 300 Hz and should gate this.

The tremor moves stock, so it changes runs that already pass. touch_matron_act's timing, matron-mischief (the toolboxes she fetches) and the stock/magnet/stack tests that find pieces by the end of the list will need retuning. New WorkLamp and edge pieces must be appended after lay_matron_throwables() so older saves still line up.

Rage feedback loop: without the 3 s window on shaken pieces, a toppled bottle 3 to 6 m from her (past kOwnSoundM) would feed her rage and she would enrage herself. The window must be cleared on restore, or checkpoint determinism breaks.

Voice rule: her breathing, the climber's held-breath release and gasps are voice and must be recorded people. The existing fall voice is TTS (licences.gd VOICE_NOTE), which already conflicts with the rule. No new TTS: the procedural breath stands in until recordings exist, and clips dropped into voice/ replace it.

Physics theater (laws 25 and 26): the decks are static bodies and must not be drawn flexing. The ring, dust and haptics present real footfalls, the chatter is real Jolt motion, and the outward creep is a documented reduced-order model with native bounds. Night and the headlamp stay presentation-only, so nothing may claim darkness hides you from her. Putting time of day and light into her sight (dark 4 m, lamp-lit 20 m, a LAMP toggle) is a real follow-on verb, but it moves time of day into the native and is the owner's call.

Performance on a Galaxy Fold 6-class phone: headlamp spot shadows, the spark lights, CPUParticles, one reverb effect and eight lit work lamps all cost frame time against 45 FPS. Shadows are kept to HIGH and above, the spark and flicker lights are pooled, and the work lamps go unshadowed with distance fade. Only the owner's device run proves it (law 29).

Haptic overload and battery: her hunting footfalls (about 2.5 a second) plus a heartbeat can buzz without a break. The design gates by felt strength (above 0.12) and fear (above 0.55), keeps the existing 50 ms coalescing, honors the vibration setting, and needs a look on the device for amplitude support.
Motion sickness: the FOV tunnel, sway, camera dips and vertigo dolly must all be off under reduced motion, and their amplitudes kept small.

Making STORY time the default changes how existing players' games and look captures appear. Append the index so saved settings keep their value, and have look tests that need a fixed hour set it, as ui_test_chase.gd already does.
result.wow: Crouched on the 143 m deck under her post at dusk, you hear her up on 154. Her shuffle turns into a hunt, and each footfall rings through the steel over your head and jolts the phone in your hands. Grit falls through your headlamp beam. A gas bottle by the rail opening chatters, creeps, tips and drops past you down the shaft, and the clang comes up from far below a moment late. Then the breathing right above you stops, and so does yours.

scores.proposal: Off Her Feet: the Matron's balance, and everything in the tower that can take it
scores.notes: The strongest spine. One physical rule (a blow is her measured change of speed, compared against a threshold set by her stance and stage) covers throws, slides, rolled mass and the Turn's wind-up. The edge catch keeps it non-lethal everywhere except the existing catwalk bolts. The music box coming off is the best story moment of the three. Checked in the code and right: caught() allows only a fixed list of states (matron.cpp:1579); post_step (physics_world.cpp ~713) runs before the caught/kills check; mAllowedDOFs is translation only and friction is 0 (matron.cpp:117-127); kOwnSoundM filters her own crash; the up-swipe with a load is a plain Jump today (affordances and the springboard are off while carrying). Mistakes found: (1) tracking her body in ImpactLedger would make her own Turn starts (kTurnFootAccel 70 m/s^2 = 0.78 m/s a tick, over kMinChangeMps 0.35) and vaults (5.2 m/s set at once) read as loud crashes. (2) It misses that a throw needs a one-body ledger resync. impacts.cpp keeps updating last_velocity through the carry, so every launch would read as a hit at the hands. (3) Laying her down with SetPositionAndRotation moves her origin, which breaks feel_floor/settle_level and the view. (4) The box cannot be picked up unless it is a kit body (carry_candidate lists only kit carryables), which contradicts 'keep it out of the kit order'. (5) A 10 m/s toolbox throw (about 900 J from the arms) is not physical. Big scope: seven milestones.

scores.proposal: Feet First: kick her down, never dead
scores.notes: Its key idea answers 'never helpless' best: the body is always there, even with no stock nearby, and she now roams the whole tower. The kick as a set-velocity exchange between two bodies works like the existing wall kick: easy, deterministic and declared. UpMove::Kick and the KICK hint already exist (simulation.hpp:618, main_context.gd:68-69). Bracing against FRONT blows she sees, with LOW and ABOVE blows that cannot be braced, gives readable counterplay that fits the balance model as a change to her step reach. The slow time has precedent (launch_shot.gd time_scale, main.gd:350) and REDUCED MOTION gating exists (main.gd:530). Weaknesses: a slow-motion boot to the chest of a sick first-aid attendant reads more action-hero than horror. The ladder stomp is a new verb built on a ladder, the owner's sore spot (plan section 2.6 rule 11). Tic-tac off her body can skip parts of the act's route. The kick must land at range and set its guard before caught() in the same tick, because contact is 0.65 m and kCatchM is 0.85. Lots of feel scope (leg, haptics, radio).

scores.proposal: Heave, Topple, Run: throw what you carry, knock her down, pay for it in rage
scores.notes: The most accurate grounding of the three. It correctly finds that caught() leaves out new states for free, that the ledger needs a resync at launch, that the lying shape must keep her mass (SetShape with mass properties recomputed would give a capsule of about 540 kg at default density), and that the ledger post_step runs before hers, so its hits can gate a blow and her own feet, rails and cages never count. The heave energy model (300 J, toolbox 5.8 m/s, drum 3.3) is physically honest. 'Rage borrowed, paid back in quiet' and the music box skipping, going silent and winding back up are excellent cues the player reads without a meter. Weaknesses: hold-Action-to-throw moves LET GO from press to release, against touch_controls.gd's 'Action fires on press' rule, and risks touch_stack/touch_wet/touch_stock. With nothing in your hands you are helpless. The centerpiece is again the ladder. It misses a real edge case: a tear-off during the mantle, after settle_level has moved her level to the 176 ring, makes the 22 m fall a death under kFallenBelowM.

synthesis.name: Off Her Feet: knock her down, never dead
synthesis.pitch: She is 220 kg on two legs or on all fours, and anything moving that meets her is measured as a blow: a toolbox heaved from your hands, your boot, your slide at her shins, an ingot dolly rolled down the band. A blow over her balance puts her down full length on the steel plates. The floor booms, the music box on her hip skips and goes silent, and for a few seconds she has no hands, no eyes and no Turn, just a body you can jump over. Every fall costs you: it feeds her rage, she gets up faster and more wrongly at each stage, and she learns. Dangerous, she braces against what she sees coming and sidesteps your throws. Fully changed, she snatches what you throw out of the air and hurls it back, and only mass, a drop from above or the half second of her Turn's wind-up still takes her legs. Knock her toward an edge and her hands always catch it; she hauls herself back over. Only the catwalk's bolts can still kill her.
mechanics: HER BALANCE (a declared reduced-order model, plan section 2.6 rule 3; the spine, from 'Off Her Feet'). A blow is the horizontal change in her speed it causes, compared against w*(b + r), where w = sqrt(g/h). Her stance comes from her state and matches the poses matron_view.gd already draws. Upright (shuffling, searching, peering, guarding, unrigging, and the Turn's wind-up): h 1.05 m, b 0.12 m. On all fours (hunting above 1 m/s, the Turn's lunges): h 0.55 m, b 0.45 m. Her step reach r by stage (CHOSEN, tuned so a full heave fells an upright pest, a drum staggers a dangerous Matron, and only mass fells her fully changed): pest 0.02 m, dangerous 0.30 m, fully changed 0.75 m. So the speed that knocks her down is about 0.43 / 1.29 / 2.66 m/s upright and 2.0 / 3.2 / 5.1 m/s on all fours. Below w*b she absorbs the blow; between the two she staggers; above it she goes down. In the Turn's wind-up r is 0, so any blow over 0.37 m/s fells her at every stage: the one warning is also the one opening. Mid-burst in a lunge r is doubled. With stock in her hands r is halved.

WHAT COUNTS AS A BLOW (merging 'Off Her Feet' and 'Heave'). walk_toward and climb store the velocity they set. In Matron::post_step, J = 220 kg times (her horizontal velocity after the step minus that stored velocity). Her friction is 0, so the floor adds nothing sideways. J counts only when a striker was closing on her this tick: a hit the ImpactLedger reports for a tracked body within reach of her (the world passes impacts_->tick() to her before post_step; it is already in tracked order), or the player's body during a kick or a slide (approach speed from pre_contact_velocity_). Her own feet, rails, cage floors and a crate at rest never count. Nothing is read from contact callbacks. The contact's height picks the kind: LOW (the striker's center under her knees, 0.5 m: a slide, a rolled drum, the dolly) takes her base, so r is 0 and she falls toward the striker. ABOVE (a body of 40 kg or more coming down onto her at 4 m/s or faster) also sets r to 0. FRONT is anything else.

BRACING (from 'Feet First'). A FRONT blow she sees coming (striker within 50 degrees of her facing, with a clear line) doubles r when she is dangerous, and fully changed only staggers her. LOW and ABOVE blows, and blows from behind, are never braced. Her counterplay is to face you; yours is to get round her, drop something on her, or go for her legs.

STAGGERING, DOWN, CRAWLING and RIM (new states appended to State after Unrigging = 9: 10, 11, 12, 13). Staggering lasts 0.4 to 1.2 s depending on how far past w*b the blow went. Her feet stop chasing and only steer her toward her capture point at her stage's recovery (4 / 9 / 16 m/s^2), so she stumbles the way she was knocked. Down: a lying capsule, a RotatedTranslatedShape swapped in with SetShape(updateMassProperties = false), so she stays 220 kg, and her origin stays at standing-center height, so feel_floor, settle_level, the fall check and the view keep working. It is laid along the fall only where a CollideShape clears; otherwise she crumples into a 0.9 m kneeling capsule. Friction 0.6 while down, so she slides about 0.75 m and stops. Down for 4.0 / 2.5 / 1.2 s by stage (CHOSEN); no blow restarts the timer. While down: no hands (caught()'s list of states already leaves her out), no eyes, the Turn ended with its cooldown restarted at her stage's value, held stock let go. She stands only where her standing capsule clears; pinned under a crate or beam she crawls out at 0.8 m/s first. For 1.5 s after rising she is set (r doubled): no stunlock.

THROW, the up-swipe with a load (the gesture from 'Off Her Feet', the energy model from 'Heave'). UpMove::Throw = 15 is appended and offered grounded with a CarryKind::Load in the hands, where that swipe is a plain Jump today. The hint THROW is drawn where the thumb swipes. The arms put up to 300 J into the load, at most 7 m/s, along the view (facing plus look pitch, raised 8 degrees), on top of the body's own speed: a toolbox 5.8 m/s, a 22 kg pallet 5.2, a drum 3.3, a pig 3.5. Reaction past 150 N*s is paid as a stumble. At launch, ImpactLedger resyncs that one body, so the throw is not heard as a crash at the hands. A thrown piece counts as handled. Its landing is a ledger hit she hears, so a throw past her is also a decoy, worn out by her existing wary/fooled rules. Action's tap LET GO is unchanged.

KICK, the up-swipe with empty hands (from 'Feet First'). Offered when her body is 1.1 to 2.6 m ahead, within 35 degrees of your facing and 1 m of your height, with a clear line; it beats vault and springboard there. It is a low, feet-first lunge: your speed plus 2.5 m/s forward and 2.0 up. It lands when your center comes within 1.15 m of hers inside 0.35 s, resolved before the caught check in that tick. The two bodies trade momentum directly, as the wall kick sets velocity: J = mu * v_close + 85 kg * 3.0 m/s, where mu = 61 kg, capped at 850 N*s (the legs' limit). She gets +J/220; you get -J/85, at most 6 m/s, so a kick never breaks your arm or throws you off a band. Her hands are off you for 0.4 s after it lands. Kicked from inside her arms (under 1.1 m), it is never offered. A miss that lands inside kCatchM is her hands' to decide, as today.

THE SLIDE (an existing move, from 'Off Her Feet'). A slide (crouch at 5 m/s or more) whose center passes under her knees while she is upright goes under her hands: caught() is false for that body, and the LOW sweep fells her at every stage outside a burst. On all fours her hands are low, and the slide runs into them: a pest shoves you, a dangerous Matron shoves you at the shaft, and fully changed it is a death. The slide counters her early and kills you late.

MASS FROM THE WORLD (all three proposals). Anything moving that meets her is measured: the ingot dolly (420 kg, friction 0.06) by the catwalk's east end, the skid crates, drums and reels knocked over to roll, forklifts, the crane's hook. Added stock, appended after the last lay_* so older saves line up: a 260 kg block trolley on every stack deck and upper ring (lay_trolleys); two free-rolling 180 kg cable reels, one on her deck's south band and one on the 176 ring; and a toolbox and a drum at the 176 ring's ladder head.

OVER AN EDGE, HER HANDS ALWAYS CATCH IT (from 'Off Her Feet' and 'Feet First'). The last floor point she stood on is recorded every tick. Off the floor while staggering or down, she builds a temporary Climb at that lip, held by a PointConstraint (on the floor's own body when it moves), and the existing climb() mantles her back: 7 / 3.5 / 1.5 s by stage. Nothing the player does makes her let go. The catwalk's bolts stay her one death, unchanged.

THE HIGH GROUND (from 'Heave'). On a climb (gravity off, climb() setting her velocity), half her threshold tears her off the rungs. A toolbox let go over the ladder's head from the 176 ring (no throw needed) hits her at about 15 m/s. She falls to the ladder's foot and lands Down, with her Turn cooldown restarted, which is her only way back onto the rungs. Her level is reset to the climb's foot level at the tear-off, so the fall to her own deck is never a death.

PAIN IS BORROWED RAGE (all three; framing from 'Heave'). A knockdown adds 0.08 to her rage and a stagger 0.02 (CHOSEN). Her own crash is within kOwnSoundM, so she never hears it. Blind on the floor, since_heard keeps running: knock her down, go quiet and get out of sight, and she stands up into Searching, then Guarding. You have lost her. Each knockdown costs about 27 s of quiet (decay 0.003 a second), so a clumsy fighter makes her dangerous and then fully changed.

WHAT SHE LEARNS, BY STAGE (learned within a run like fooled_, forgotten on a restore). A pest answers nothing. Her existing mischief takes what you threw and throws it back. Dangerous, she braces against frontal blows she sees. After two blows in a run she sidesteps a throw she saw leave your hands (kCutAccel, away from the shaft's rim). Once a rolling body has felled her, she sidesteps the ones she sees closing at 2 m/s or more with under 0.6 s to contact (never mid-burst). Fully changed, she catches a thrown piece of 60 kg or less that she sees, within 0.9 m of her hands (take_stock on a 'piece in flight' slot in throwables_), and hurls it back at kThrowMps after 0.2 s. A felt hit, never a death. Then only mass, drops, unseen blows and the wind-up work.

THE MUSIC BOX COMES OFF (from 'Off Her Feet'). It is a 0.6 kg MusicBox stock kind appended after the last lay_*, a kit body so the player can carry it, held at her hip by a constraint. A knockdown 1.5 times past her threshold parts the cord, and the box skitters off with her hip's velocity, still playing; its 90 s spring runs down. After she stands, a pest or a dangerous Matron goes to it before going after you and ties it back on (4 s / 2 s). Within 6 m of it, while it plays, her rage falls 4 times as fast. Picked up by the player, it is a sound she hears every tick and hunts. Let go onto the deck below, it leaves her at the rail over it, listening down, until it runs down. Lost out of her hearing, her rage never falls below 0.30 again. Fully changed, it draws her nowhere.

READ WITHOUT A METER (from 'Heave' and 'Feet First'). The music box skips on every blow and goes silent while she is down. When it starts again, slow and winding up, she is getting up. How she rises shows her stage: a pest's slow push-up on thin arms; dangerous, up from knees bent backward; fully changed, her head turns to you first while her body is still flat, then she comes up stiff as a plank. You hear 220 kg on steel plate, a bone crack, and a haptic pulse scaled by the blow. A brief slow time (0.25 s at 0.35x, presentation only, launch_shot's method) plays on a kick or a wind-up knockdown, and REDUCED MOTION turns it off. No synthesized voice: her cry is a recorded person or nothing. Walt's radio, as captions until recorded, each line set off once by native state: 'Did you just knock her down? She's sick, Navarro. Don't hurt her, just keep her off you.' / 'Whatever you're doing to her, stop. She's getting worse.' / 'Don't let her fall. Please.'

milestones.title: 1. Her balance, the blow, and down (still standing)
milestones.what: In matron.cpp: stance from state, the stage step-reach table, the blow measured in post_step from her horizontal velocity change against what walk_toward/climb set, counted only with a closing striker (the ledger's hits this tick within reach, passed in before post_step). Staggering and Down appended (Down a timer with her standing capsule, feet off, friction 0.6). Hands off through caught()'s list; restore() and refresh_view's released list gain the new states; the Turn ends with its stage cooldown; held stock is let go; pain feeds rage. View and bridge fields: knockdowns, staggers, down, balance. In matron_view.gd, a first sprawl (the figure tipped along the fall) and a 220 kg-on-steel thud cue from the knockdown counter. Her body is not added to the ledger.
milestones.proof: New native group SCRAPERX_ONLY=matron-balance: (a) the dolly pushed into a pest coming up the east band: knockdowns 1, shoves 0, down at least 3.5 s, rage up at least 0.08, deaths 0. (b) debug stage 1, the same push at a walk into her on all fours: staggers at least 1, knockdowns 0. (c) Her full-speed hunt past the east band's skid crates and along the shaft rail, and a ride in Stage A's cage: no blow at all. (d) A crate shoved into her during the wind-up: turn 0, cooldown restarted. (e) A restore mid-Down: Emerging at her locker. Then determinism with a knockdown in its inputs, and matron, matron-collision and matron-mischief still pass. look_matron_gallery gains a 'down_pest' PNG (Xvfb plus --capture).

milestones.title: 2. THROW on the up-swipe
milestones.what: UpMove::Throw = 15 appended, offered grounded with a CarryKind::Load; resolve_up turns it into a throw request; update_carry lets go and launches on the 300 J model (at most 7 m/s plus the body's speed, along the view raised 8 degrees), the reaction past 150 N*s paid as a stumble. A new ImpactLedger::resync_body(entity) at launch. A thrown piece is marked handled. THROW appended to UP_HINTS, drawn where the thumb swipes.
milestones.proof: SCRAPERX_ONLY=handling extended: a toolbox leaves the hands at 5.5-6.1 m/s relative to the body, a drum at 3.0-3.6; no ledger hit on the launch tick, one on landing. matron-balance: a standing full heave of the toolbox fells an upright pest and only staggers a dangerous one. A new touch scenario, touch_heave (154 m deck: PICK UP the north band's toolbox, the up hint reads THROW, swipe, carrying 0, the box at least 4 m off); touch_stack, touch_wet and touch_stock still pass.

milestones.title: 3. Body blows: KICK, bracing and the slide
milestones.what: update_up_move offers UpMove::Kick for her body on the ground (1.1-2.6 m, 35 degrees, a clear line), beating vault and springboard. The lunge kick resolves at 1.15 m before the caught check: the momentum trade capped at 850 N*s, the player's rebound at most 6 m/s, her hands off for 0.4 s. Bracing against FRONT blows she sees (dangerous r doubled, fully changed frontal only staggers); LOW and ABOVE never braced. The slide: caught() false for a sliding body under the knees of an upright Matron; into her on all fours, her hands as today.
milestones.proof: New group matron-kick. A standing pest kicked from 2 m: knockdown, no shove, no death, her held toolbox let go. Dangerous, facing: staggered, not down; the same kick from behind: down. Fully changed, frontal: stagger only, the player thrown back at most 6 m/s, no death, no arm broken. From 3 m, KICK not offered. A slide under an upright searching pest: knockdowns +1, deaths 0. A slide into a fully changed Matron hunting on all fours: death_count +1. determinism passes. A new touch scenario, touch_matron_kick: KICK shown with her 2 m ahead, swiped, downs at least 1, deaths 0.

milestones.title: 4. A body on the floor
milestones.what: The lying RotatedTranslatedShape via SetShape(updateMassProperties = false), origin kept at standing height, laid only where a CollideShape clears, else the kneeling crumple. Getting up only where the standing capsule clears; Crawling out from under a crate or beam; the 1.5 s set after rising; a down timer no blow restarts. Gallery poses: down, crawl, the three rises.
milestones.proof: matron-balance: after a knockdown her shape's bounding box is under 0.7 m tall and her mass is still 220 kg. The player goes over her (feet above 154.5 m at her x) with no death. A skid crate shoved onto her legs gives crawls 1 before she stands. The dolly left resting against her: knockdowns still 1 after 10 s. A restore mid-Down gives the standing shape at her locker. A knockdown beside the shaft rail launches nothing (no body faster than 3 m/s afterward). PNGs from look_matron_gallery.

milestones.title: 5. Edges and the high ground
milestones.what: The last floor point recorded every tick; off a floor while staggering or down, a temporary Climb at the lip with a PointConstraint, mantled back by climb() in 7 / 3.5 / 1.5 s. On a climb, half her threshold tears her off: climb_ ends, gravity comes back, her level resets to the climb's foot level, and she lands Down with her Turn cooldown restarted. A toolbox and a drum appended at the 176 ring's ladder head. Rim-hang and torn-off poses.
milestones.proof: New group matron-rim. The dolly shoved into her at the catwalk's east mouth: rim_hangs 1, alive, feet back on the band within 7.5 s as a pest and 2 s fully changed, the player's death_count unchanged. The existing catwalk test (her weight shears a plate, state Dead) still passes in matron. Ladder: in her Turn about 5 m up, the ring-head toolbox let go onto her: torn_off 1, alive at floor_y 154, Down; a pest does not take hold again for at least 40 s; debug stage 2, the drum tears her off. milestones.title: 6. What she learns, and more mass
milestones.what: Dangerous: after two blows, a sidestep from a throw she saw (kCutAccel, away from the rim); after being felled by a rolling body, a sidestep from the ones she sees closing. Fully changed: catching seen pieces of 60 kg or less on a 'piece in flight' slot and throwing them back at kThrowMps. All forgotten on a restore. The block trolley (lay_trolleys) on every stack deck and upper ring, and two free-rolling cable reels, appended last.
milestones.proof: matron-balance stage cases with debug_set_matron_stage. Dangerous after two hits: a third throw seen leaving the hands misses (dodges 1, nearest approach over 0.6 m), while one from behind as she peers at a dropped lure lands. Fully changed: a toolbox thrown in her sight is in her hands within 0.4 s and comes back (throws +1, the player's hit_count +1, no death). Fully changed: the dolly fells her (blow at least 600 N*s), a trolley sent after a first one is dodged (dodges +1). A restore forgets it all. save and stock pass with the new stock appended.

milestones.title: 7. The music box comes off
milestones.what: MusicBox appended as a 0.6 kg Load kit body, held at her hip by a constraint. A knockdown 1.5 times past her threshold parts it; a 90 s spring; a pest or a dangerous Matron goes to it first and ties it on; rage falls 4 times as fast near it while it plays; carried by the player it is a lead each tick; let go onto the deck below, she stands at the rail over it; lost out of hearing, her rage floor is 0.30; fully changed, ignored. matron_music plays at the box's body; it skips on every blow, goes silent while she is down, and winds back up as she rises.
milestones.proof: New group matron-box: a dolly knockdown gives box_loose true and the box body on the deck; once she stands, her target is the box before the player; near it her rage falls at 4 times 0.003 a second; PICK UP gives her a lead on it each tick; let go through 143's gate onto the 143 m band, she stays on her deck over that place until the spring runs down; debug stage 2, a loose box draws her nowhere. save passes with the box body appended.

milestones.title: 8. The feel, and played by touch through all three stages
milestones.what: Haptic pulse scaled by the blow (main_feel _haptic), the brief slow time on a kick or a wind-up knockdown (off under REDUCED MOTION), the first-person kick leg, Walt's three lines as captions in foreman_radio.gd, the stumble and sprawl poses polished to fill the collision shape. A new touch playthrough, touch_matron_bay (ui_test_bay.gd extending ui_test_chase.gd), from the 154 m deck: wake her; as a pest, kick her down and slide under her hands; THROW the toolbox into a Turn's wind-up; dangerous, get behind her and roll the dolly into her at the catwalk's east mouth (rim hang); the box as a lure; fully changed, only mass and the wind-up; up the ladder, and drop the ring-head toolbox on her as she follows. Progress log entry; 00_START_HERE's directive row marked built.
milestones.proof: tools/godot/godot --headless --fixed-fps 60 --path godot -- --uitest=touch_matron_bay passes and fails if any beat is missing in the simulation (knockdowns, staggers, rim_hangs, torn_off and box_loose read from the native; deaths only where the scenario means one). It asserts a haptic pulse at the first knockdown, and that slow time fires and is absent with REDUCED MOTION. With Xvfb and --capture, screenshots of each knockdown, the rim haul-up, the torn-off fall and the loose box. touch_matron_act still passes unchanged, and CI's touch list gains touch_heave, touch_matron_kick and touch_matron_bay.

risks: Laying her down next to rails, stock or the player can overlap bodies, and Jolt then launches them apart. Both the swap and the rise must pass a CollideShape test, with the kneeling crumple as the fallback.

SetShape with mass properties recomputed would give the capsule its density mass (about 540 kg at Jolt's default density), not 220 kg. Pass updateMassProperties = false and keep the origin at standing height, or her floor probes (feel_floor, settle_level, the fall check) and the view break while she is down.

Her body must not be tracked in the ImpactLedger. Her Turn starts (0.78 m/s a tick) and vaults (5.2 m/s set at once) exceed kMinChangeMps and would play and propagate as crashes. Her landing on the plates is a dedicated event from the Down transition.
Without a one-body ledger resync at launch, every throw reads as a crash at the hands (about 300 J or more) that she hears, because post_step keeps last_velocity through the carry.

restore() and refresh_view's released list must include the new states. Otherwise freezes_checkpoint() goes false while she is down, the checkpoint renews beside her body, and a restore mid-Down leaves her out of the world.
Ladder tear-off: settle_level can move her level to the 176 ring during the mantle, and a 22 m fall then counts as a death under kFallenBelowM. Reset her level to the climb's foot level on tear-off.

Hands before contact: the player's capsule meets hers at 0.65 m, inside kCatchM 0.85. The kick must land at range and set its guard before the caught check in the same tick, and the slide-under rule must live in caught(), or body blows become deaths or shoves.

Determinism: blows only from post-step state and the ledger's tracked order (or a max with a total-order tie-break if contacts are ever used). Determinism between ARM devices and x86 CI is still not established for any of this.

Balance tuning: every step reach, down time, rage cost and the 300 J heave are CHOSEN, and there is no device in the container to tune feel by thumb. Too easy and she stops being scary; too stingy and the player is helpless again. Rage per knockdown may push a clumsy player to fully changed early, so its cause must read through the music box and Walt.
Stunlock: a dolly or trolley pinned against her must not re-fell her every tick. The 1.5 s set and a down timer no blow restarts must hold, and a test covers it.

Rim catches on moving floors (cages) and odd geometry (the 1.09 m gap at the 176 ring's cages, a plate that then shears) need the constraint on the floor's body. A plate shearing under her hands is a death by design and must read as fair.
Tone: kicking a sick first-aid attendant can read as action-hero rather than horror. Keep the slow time brief and rare, let Walt's lines carry the guilt, and keep her rises terrible.

Voices: matron_breath and matron_shriek are synthesized today in sound_bank.gd. The owner's rule is recorded human voices only, so no new synthesized cry is added and the existing ones should be raised with the owner.
Save layout: the trolleys, reels, ring-head stock and the music box are kit bodies appended after the last lay_*, or older saves lose their stock positions. Run save and stock.

The up-swipe now means THROW with a load and KICK near her. Any player habit or scenario that jumps with a load, or jumps toward her, changes. Tic-tac or kick hops off her body could skip parts of her act's route.
The ladder moment uses the existing 154-176 ladder and adds none, but the owner dislikes ladders, so it stays one graft, not the centerpiece.
Cost on a phone: CollideShape and shape casts only on ticks with a blow, or while she is staggering, down, crawling or rising.
synthesis.wow: The Turn: her spine cracks, she rears upright and shaking, and the music box warps. You have the toolbox in your hands and swipe up. It hits her square in the wind-up and she goes over backward full length onto the deck plates: the boom of 220 kg on steel, a thump in your hand. The cord at her hip snaps and the music box skitters off across the plates, still playing, slowing as its spring runs down. On the floor her head turns the wrong way round, toward the box and not you, and she drags herself after it on her elbows. You have about four seconds, and you didn't kill her.

scores.proposal: Her Tower: the Matron as the tower's other climber
scores.notes: Strongest engineering spine. Her map is generated from collision (sheets, members, links), with a CI drift check like world_solids.inc. Moving links (lines, rides, route decks) are attached at runtime. It sets a per-tick perf budget, saves her as an optional trailing block in the pattern the grips use, and adds rich snapshot fields. 'Her hands carry her real weight, with a finite grip' is the most causal idea of the three. Grounding errors I found by reading: there is no 200 kg oil drum (LooseStock: Drum 55 kg, Toolbox 18 kg not 15, and the carry holds about 70 kg). Deck 7's equipment hatch is an open hole in build_stack, not a hinged kit plate. Jolt's RotationEulerConstraintPart swaps identity in for zero-inertia columns and only calls Deactivate if that still fails. That is harmless on static steel, but a SliderConstraint to a dynamic hold would lock the hold's rotation to her rotation-locked capsule. Milestone 1 is a bake with no change in play. Its scope (joints, the 59-degree brace crawl, transfers, cut-off, the frame path, about 1,400 nodes, a SliderConstraint hold) is the largest and riskiest. The ladder, pole, grip and leg-squeeze numbers are good material to graft.

scores.proposal: She Knows the Steel: the Matron anywhere in the tower
scores.notes: Best player experience and best ordering. A hand-placed slice on one corner pipe comes first, so the gasp is on the phone before the general system exists. It also brings the 4-second tell contract, the shaft look, the watched link ('you watch her decide'), spoiled links, variety from a deterministic hash, the &"her" haptic counted in haptic_counts, and audio muffled by mirroring the player_carry that pre_step already computes. Knock-down-a-storey uses links whose stops are at most 11.5 m apart (under kFallenBelowM 12), so a knock can never kill her, and the stock masses are correct. Flaws, measured from world_solids.inc: its corner line (0.65 m off the axis, 0.19 m clear) collides with each 1.1 m flange and with the corner of the square 0.7 m pipe. Her capsule fits the corner only at about 0.8 m from the axis, 9 cm from each shaft edge beam, and every flange stands in that line. Bumping save_format_key would refuse older saves, where the grips' optional-trailing-block pattern keeps them loading. A new ladder on each ring corner goes against rule 11 (the owner's 'chutes and ladders' complaint) even when labeled a rule-8 backup. The headless crossing proof in the bake adds CI time.

scores.proposal: The Riser Road: her whole tower, deck to deck
scores.notes: Pragmatic. It reuses today's climb motion and keeps the hand-written 154 deck and 176 ring (catwalk, posts, eyes, unrigging) with generated spurs. Links get phases (approach, mount, traverse, dismount) with time budgets and a 20 s refusal. Heard leads are worth a different route cost by stage, only large sheets muffle as decks, it adds no new ladders (rule 11), and decision 9 C ('she learns the lifts') comes later. It correctly notes that Kit has no guide listing. Weaker points: building the graph at load from Jolt queries risks a different graph on an ARM phone than on x86 CI (rule 10's open item), so its baked fallback should be the default. Its brace rule (15 to 35 degrees) does not match the 59.4-degree StackBrace and the about 23-degree UpperBrace in world_solids.inc. A pest riding parked trolleys spends the player's one trolley per line. The knock-off is a bare impulse threshold, with no physical slide to a flange. 'Drops up to 11.5 m' mostly do not exist in the Stack, because the decks stack directly over an open shaft. The clang-per-deck wow is the least physical of the three.

synthesis.name: She Knows the Steel
synthesis.pitch: After her first act you never again know which floor she is on. You only know how she is coming, and you always hear it first. Every ladder you climbed, every lift you rode and every line you slid is hers too. So are the four corner pipes in the shaft, which your hands cannot close round, and once she is fully changed, the columns on the outside of the tower. The game finds these ways in the tower's own steel, so she arrives somewhere real, at a speed you could time, after a sound that warned you: a hollow knock for each handhold, a bong at each flange, a rung's clang. Her hands carry her real weight, so an oil drum let go over the rail tears her off the pipe. She shrieks down a storey and slams onto the flange below, alive and angrier, and picks another way. The quieter you are, the less of the building is hers.
mechanics: THE CONTRACT (what the player can count on, and what is tested). (1) Before she stands on your level, there are always at least 4 s of her link's sound. (2) Her stage changes how she moves and how far she will chase, never whether she can go up and down. (3) A knock never kills her: she only takes links whose stops (floors, flanges, ladder feet) are at most 11.5 m apart, under kFallenBelowM 12. The rotten catwalk on 154 is still the one thing that kills her. (4) A death never puts her back within 20 s of you. (5) Nothing appears on the HUD. You read her by sound, sight and the phone in your hand.

HER MAP, BAKED FROM THE STEEL (P1's structure, P3's box rules, P2's proof). A native bake mode (SCRAPERX_ONLY=matron-map-bake ./build/host/scraperx_sim_tests) builds the whole world at rest and writes src/sim/matron_map.inc as constexpr tables. CI regenerates it and diffs it, as the workflow already does for world_solids.inc. It reads static bodies and static kit route parts only, inside the tower footprint plus each machine frame grown by 3 m, so trees, lamp masts and the yard stay out. FLOORS: box leaves with a level top at least 0.48 m across (her existing 2 x kFootSpanM rule) and 2.15 m of headroom. They join into SHEETS when their tops are within 0.35 m and they touch within kStepOverM 0.45, by union-find in a fixed order. A sheet is marked a DECK (it muffles sound) only above 50 m^2. WALK LINES: the center line of each floor box, plus connectors where boxes overlap. Each line is checked with her capsule sweep (way_clear's rule), moved up to 3 m inside its box if blocked, and otherwise dropped and listed. Deck 7's hatch (z -148.70 to -145.00) breaks the east band's loop by itself. MEMBERS, sorted with the player's own box_is_hold (kGripMaxSection 0.18): rung runs at 0.45 m pitch or less are LADDERS. Vertical 0.3 to 0.9 m members are PIPES (the four corner pipes, flanges recorded as stops). Vertical 0.9 to 1.8 m members are COLUMNS (the Stack's outer columns, the rings' UpperColumn stack). Tilted ones are BRACES (StackBrace at 59.4 degrees, UpperBrace at about 23). LINKS record their kind, both ends, her line (a polyline swept clear with her capsule), their stops, a cost for each stage and a stage mask. Drops, haul-ups and gaps come from probes along each floor box's free edges. In the bake, a headless Matron crosses every candidate link, and failures are dropped and listed. Baked, not built at load, because ARM-to-x86 determinism is not established (rule 10): a table is the same graph on every phone and costs nothing at startup. AT RUNTIME the moving links are added: lines from Zipline::lines() (down only), rides from Kit guides (a small new accessor set: guide_count, guide_body, guide_axis, guide_limits) and vertical::Route decks (open only while a deck stands at her end). The catwalk keeps its sight-commit rule. HAND-WRITTEN LEVELS WIN (P3): the 154 deck and the 176 ring keep their posts, cage eyes, catwalk and unrigging, and the generated sheets only add spurs to them. The bake prints a CONNECTIVITY REPORT (every sheet against every sheet, up and down, by stage) as a test artifact, and any level she cannot reach is named for the owner.

HOW SHE MOVES ON A LINK (P3's phases, P1's physics, simplified). One link mover with four phases. APPROACH: walk to the foot along the sheet's lines. MOUNT: over a shaft rail, onto a pipe, or off a deck edge, as a driven transfer with collisions on, at most 12 m/s^2, within a 2 s budget. TRAVERSE. DISMOUNT: today's mantle (kMantleOutM). A phase that overruns its budget (a crate on a ladder's head, a cage gone) makes her back off, refuse that link for 20 s (generalizing fetch_refused_) and replan. HANDS THAT CARRY HER WEIGHT: gravity stays on, replacing climb()'s SetGravityFactor(0) and SetLinearVelocity. Each tick her hands apply a force along her line toward her stage speed, capped at her pull (3,400 N up, 1.6 times her 2,158 N weight) and her squeeze (3,000 N going down). A capped sideways force holds her to the line. A 160 kg crate settled on her outweighs her spare pull, so she stalls and sinks. On a dynamic hold the opposite force goes into that body, so the structure feels her. Her hold load (0..1) is published so the steel groans in proportion. The fallback if force control jitters at 90 Hz is Jolt's SliderConstraint with a velocity motor (MotorSettings, SetTargetVelocity, GetTotalLambdaPosition, checked in build/host/_deps/jolt-src) on static steel only.

THE CORNER PIPES (the signature link, measured). Each pipe is a 0.7 m square box 1.2 m in from both shaft edges, with a 1.1 m flange 1.4 m under every deck. Her capsule fits the corner between the pipe and the shaft's corner at about 0.8 m from the pipe's axis, 9 cm from each shaft edge beam. The pipe's corner, not its face, sets that. Every flange stands in this line, so each flange is a physical rest. Climbing, she swings round it hand over hand to the shaft side and back, and the flange bongs as her weight comes onto it. Sliding, she lands on it, a real contact. The corner is also right under the rails' corner, where something let go over the rail falls. 0.7 m is too thick for the player's hands, so the pipes are hers alone. If the bake's sweep finds the corner too tight, the four pipes move 0.3 to 0.4 m into the shaft in main_world.gd and world_solids.inc is regenerated, which opens a 0.8 m corner.

HER STAGE DECIDES HOW, AND HOW FAR (P2's manners, P3's lead worth). PEST: a slow old woman in the pipes. Ladders up at 0.4 m/s and down backward at 0.5. Pipes feet first at 0.4 m/s, with a breath at each flange. Rides already standing at her floor and going her way, or with the player aboard. Never the cable or the outside steel, and no drop over 1.2 m. DANGEROUS: pipes up at 0.7 m/s, down in a slide held to 3 m/s by forearms and knees with a bong at each flange, ladders at 0.9, the bare cable of a ridden line (today's move), and hang-drops up to 3 m. FULLY CHANGED: the outside of the tower is hers. Stack columns and the inside face of the diagrid, the rings' corner columns and chevrons, head first down pipes, hang-drops up to 6.5 m (each with a 1.5 s look over the edge, so the tell holds), and climbs in kClimbBurstMps jerks. The Turn keeps its meaning. A HEARD lead is worth chasing only within a route cost of 40 s as a pest, 150 s when dangerous, and any distance fully changed. A seen lead is always worth it. So a quiet climber leaves her behind, the owner's rule. Today's 'frail, she stands at the ladder's foot' becomes 'a pest climbs it slowly'.

THE KNOCK: KEEPING HER AT BAY WITHOUT KILLING HER. While she is on a link, a hit is read from her own motion, the way ImpactLedger reads every tracked body: her velocity after the step against what her hands and gravity would give. The bake keeps her line clear of static steel except at stops, so only something hitting her registers. A hit of more than 1.4 m/s (about 300 N s on 220 kg; 2.1 in the Turn) opens her hands. ON A PIPE her legs stay wrapped. She slides on 1,200 N of leg squeeze, under her weight (about 4.4 m/s^2 down), to the next flange and slams onto it at about 10 m/s after a storey. She is stunned 0.25 s for each m/s over 5 and hangs there, then climbs again or goes another way. OFF A LADDER she falls to its foot, which is always a floor. OFF A COLUMN (inside face) she falls to the deck below. With real stock: a 55 kg drum or a 60 kg gas bottle let go from a storey above (about 500 N s) knocks her off. A 50 kg iron pig from 3 m is borderline. A thrown 18 kg toolbox (about 135 N s) does not. A knocked link is spoiled for her for 30 s, and each knock adds 0.08 to her rage, so every knock buys time and makes her worse.

HER SENSES ACROSS LEVELS. HEARING stays carry_m(), with decks_between() counting the baked deck sheets instead of levels_. HEAVY HITS also carry through the frame: horizontal distance plus twice the vertical, so a beam dropped on the deck under hers is felt and one three decks down is not (P1). SIGHT drops the same-level gate (pre_step's 'perceivable'), so the geometry decides: decks block and the open shaft does not. Two rays kEyesHalfM apart, every tick within kSightM 9, every 3rd tick on a fixed phase out to kCommitSightM 50. THE SHAFT LOOK: searching, she goes to the nearest shaft rail and looks up for 2.5 s, then down for 2.5 s. That is where she finds you, and where you see her face. THE STEEL CARRIES BOTH WAYS: your hands on her link (within 0.6 m of its line) tell her exactly where you are. LEADS go to the sheet under the sound. A sound on a link makes the link the lead and its far end her guess, generalizing guess_line_ and guess_climb_. THE TRAIL: in sight she reads a line with no trolley parked at its top, or a cage at the far end of its travel, as a lead to its far end.

HOW SHE CHOOSES A WAY. One Dijkstra over the baked graph: at most about 600 nodes (link ends plus sheet line nodes), in fixed scratch arrays with no allocation (route_toward copies its vectors on every call today). The cost of an edge is walking metres over her speed, plus each link's time at her stage, plus 1.5 s to get on or off, plus penalties. Links her stage cannot take are left out. She replans when her lead changes sheet, every 45 ticks on a fixed phase, at a link's head, and when a ride leaves her end. Once on a link she finishes it, unless turning back costs under 60% of going on. INTERCEPT: with you on a link, if she can reach its far end first she goes there and waits, silent, facing down it. You climb toward her face. WATCHED LINK: a link whose head you stand within 3 m of costs 25 s more. She stops at the ladder's foot, looks up at you and walks off toward a corner pipe, and you watch her decide. VARIETY WITHOUT RANDOMNESS: costs within 10% of each other are settled by a hash of (link, lead sheet, tick / 900), so she is not always at the same corner and a replay is identical. LOST: she searches the lead's sheet, does a shaft look, then drifts one level toward the last loud sound. No lead, no plan. Her pest mischief (fetch, throw, carry to her post) runs as today on whatever sheet she is on.

YOU HEAR HER, YOU FEEL HER (P2). Each link has its own sound, all of them structure or machine sounds placed at her hands. Ladder: a clang per rung (built). Pipe: a hollow knock per handhold, a deeper bong at each flange, the pipe ringing on after. Column: palm slaps and a long creak. Cable: her forearms screeching (built). Drop: a landing that booms through the deck, fed into the impact ledger so it is one system with every other hit. Mantle: fingers scraping the edge beam, one palm slapped flat, then her head. The rhythm gives away her stage: as a pest a knock every 1.2 s and a breath at each flange; fully changed, three quick knocks and then silence. The native exports the carry and the decks between her and the player, and the view muffles her music box, breath and knocks by exactly that. A new &"her" haptic in main_feel.gd pulses for each of her handholds on the steel you are on or holding (fading out by 12 m along it), and once, heavily, when she lands on your floor within 15 m. It is counted in haptic_counts so CI can check it. Her breath and any effort sounds are recorded human voices, with placeholders until someone records them.

CHECKPOINT AND SAVE WITH HER ANYWHERE. freezes_checkpoint() changes from player_on_deck_ to: she sees the player, or her planned time to the player's footing is under 20 s (cached every 0.5 s and recomputed at once after a restore). Matron::Saved gains her last firm footing (sheet, x, y, z, yaw), her state and her lead. A commit made while she is on a link saves the foot she left from. restore() puts her there instead of at her locker: Searching with no lead, keeping her rage, stage and exposure, and forgetting what she learned, as today. On disk, an optional block goes after the grips in write_save()/read_save() (the existing 'ok && !r.done()' pattern), so older saves still load, with her sealed.

CHEAP AND DETERMINISTIC ON A PHONE. Baked constexpr tables, integer indices, fixed evaluation order, index tie-breaks, and a cadence set by the tick count. No clock and no randomness. Per tick: at most 2 sight rays close by, far sight every 3rd tick, carry_m on the 4 nearest of up to 16 sounds, a replan at most every 0.5 s (about 50 microseconds over 600 nodes). Her edge rays stay, because they see cages and moved stock. A perf line logs her microseconds per tick (host mean at most 0.1 ms, worst at most 1 ms on a replan tick). Static-floor edge checks move to baked lookups only if the phone profiler asks for it. The native determinism test runs a cross-tower chase twice and compares bit for bit.

HER WEIGHT ON MACHINES. She is a real 220 kg body in every cage. A ride table runs each lift with her aboard (Stage A: 350 kg cage against an 800 kg skip; S1's water balance; S2's walking beam; S3; the vertical machines) and records what it does. No lift is left with the player having no way on (rule 5: the parachute is the way back). Later, decision 9 C: she starts a machine with her body only once she has seen the player start it this run, and a restore makes her forget.

SEEN DOING IT. MatronSnapshot gains link_kind, link_phase, link_progress, hold_load, slide_mps, slam_mps, stun_s and sheet_y. matron_view.gd's _pose() gets branches beside climbing, on_line and clinging. Pipe: wedged in the corner, knees up, feet first as a pest, head first spidering when fully changed. The swing round each flange. Her hand first over every edge: 0.6 s of fingers curling over the beam before her head. The shaft look: head tipped back past straight up, jaw slack, lit by the deck's lamp. The column crawl. The knocked-off slide and slam. The crumple and the wrong-limbed stand-up. Her figure is drawn on any level within DRAW_RANGE_M 140.
grounding: src/sim/matron.cpp Matron::Matron(): levels_ is hand-written: the 154 deck (11 nodes, catwalk edge 7-3, ladder spur 8-9-10, post kPostX -10.3 / kPostZ -129.0, eye), the 176 ring (Gap edge {10,1}, posts by B's cage), 10 upper rings (kRingPitch 22, kRingStepIn 0.91) with way -1 and no posts, and kStackDecks 13 copies of the deck's 8-node band loop. climbs_ holds one ladder: {kLadderX 5.0, kLadderFootZ -129.55, 154 to kRingFloor 176.25, out north}. The header says C3's riser ladder is deliberately not a climb.

src/sim/matron.cpp route_toward() copies level.nodes and level.edges into new vectors on every call (Dijkstra over about a dozen nodes) and falls back with way_clear() (3 static-only rays at feet_y_ + 0.9 across her width). onto_floor_lines(), floor_of() (a level within -0.5..8 m) and settle_level() (|feet_y_ - floor_y| < 0.6) all go through levels_.

src/sim/matron.cpp walk_toward(): edge_at() samples 4 points out to kStepOverM 0.45, each a floor_at() of 3 rays (middle and kFootSpanM 0.24 to each side). It is called ahead, at the stopping distance, and on up to 4 sides: up to about 72 rays a tick. Also the Turn's leap (kLeapReachM 3.0) and vault probes.

src/sim/matron.cpp follow_climb(): with turn_ == Turn::None she stands at the foot and returns (the frail rule). climb() sets gravity factor 0, drives velocity with kClimbMps 0.6, kClimbBurstMps 2.2 and kClimbAccel 70, then mantles to kMantleOutM 1.0. It only goes up.

src/sim/matron.cpp follow_line()/ride_line(): Turn only, never down a parked line, Zipline::clip_other(best, body_, hands, true), kCableFriction applied as a brake squeeze. feel_floor() clings above kRideMps 0.3 and lets go after kLetGoSeconds.

src/sim/matron.cpp pre_step(): on_deck is the player within feet_y_-1..+6 inside |x|<27, z -177..-123. perceivable = on_deck || player_climb. sees() is two rays kEyesHalfM 0.15 apart. sees_far_ adds a sees() call each tick out to kCommitSightM 50. player_carry = carry_m(player, ear) is computed every tick (it can be exported for the view).

src/sim/matron.cpp carry_m()/decks_between(): an all-hit ray whose static, up-facing hits are matched to levels_ floor_y within kDeckDepthM 0.6. kDeckMuffle 10, kBendMuffle 1.4, kShaftHalfM 17. post_step() kills her below floor_y - kFallenBelowM 12 unless riding_, on_line_ or climb_ >= 0.

milestones.title: M1. The corner pipe, felt (hand-placed, before any bake)
milestones.what: Generalize Climb into a two-way Link {kind ladder|pipe, a polyline line, foot, head, stops}. Hand-place the north-east corner pipe's storey links 132 to 143 to 154, and make her ladder two-way. Add the link mover's phases (approach, mount over the corner rail, traverse, dismount) with budgets and the 20 s refusal. Her hands become a capped force with gravity on (pull 3,400 N, squeeze 3,000 N). Each stage gets its manner on the pipe (pest feet first at 0.4 m/s with a breath at each flange; dangerous 0.7 up and a 3 m/s slide down; fully changed head first in jerks). Her line is placed by a capsule sweep in the corner, with the swing round each flange. Add the knock (a residual velocity change over 1.4 m/s), the leg-wrap slide to the flange below, the slam, the stun, the spoiled link and +0.08 rage. Add the pipe knock and flange bong as structure sounds, the &"her" haptic, and the pipe-wrap and slide poses. Re-stage touch_matron_act's 143 beat on purpose: made dangerous by sprints on 143, she comes down the pipe; the climber lets the drum go over the corner rail onto her and goes up C3 while she hangs stunned.
milestones.proof: New native SCRAPERX_ONLY=matron-pipe. (1) At each stage she goes 154 to 132 and back, alive, never more than 0.2 m off her line except during the flange swings. (2) At least 4 s of knocks before she stands on the player's level. (3) A 55 kg drum let go over 143's corner rail lands on her line and knocks her off: she slides to the 132 flange (slam at most 11 m/s), alive, stunned at least 2 s, then climbs again or takes another way. (4) A thrown 18 kg toolbox (7.5 m/s) leaves her on. (5) Without the change, a test placing her on the pipe fails. Also: `matron` (every section; 'climb' and 'two below' revised on purpose and listed in the progress log), `matron-mischief`, `matron-collision`, `determinism`. Touch: `touch_matron_act` re-staged (the knock is a required beat, and haptic_counts[&"her"] > 0), `touch_matron_climb`. A --capture from 143's corner rail looking down the pipe.

The connectivity report by stage is a test artifact. A preview-only overlay of sheets and links is captured from outside the tower for review. At runtime: lines from Zipline::lines(). The generated stack decks replace the kStackDecks copies and the hand-placed pipe links, while the 154 deck and 176 ring stay hand-written with generated spurs. All four pipes (52 storey links), her ladder, C3's wall and riser ladders, and C2's ladder at deck 7's hatch. One global Dijkstra in fixed scratch arrays. Stage gates, and lead worth by stage (40 s, 150 s, any). Split matron.cpp: links and routing into their own files.
milestones.proof: New native `matron-map`. (1) A rebake is byte-identical to matron_map.inc, and CI fails on drift. (2) 14 stack sheets, with deck 7's east band split at z -148.70..-145.00. (3) The generated 154 loop lies within 0.25 m of today's hand-written one, and M1's hand links are found again within 5 cm. (4) 52 pipe links with flanges as stops. Every link has stops at most 11.5 m apart. The 0.3 m boards and the standpipe to 198 are not feet. (5) Dangerous, every stack deck reaches every other, up and down. New `matron-reach`: from her locker to deck 1 (11 m) and back at each stage, arrival times logged, no deaths.
